rules.note: Dispatch does not use domain/application/infrastructure layers.
Dispatch does not use domain/application/infrastructure layers.
Dispatch domains import each other's models and flows by design; the boundary is views→service, see VIEW-001.

rules.title: A views.py never imports another domain's service
rules.statement: HTTP endpoints call their own domain's flows/service; cross-domain work goes through flows.py (ARCHITECTURE.md rule 1).

rules.title: Enum values are persisted: changing one needs a data migration
rules.statement: DispatchEnum values are stored as strings in PostgreSQL and referenced by the UI and the Slack plugin; a change ships with an Alembic revision (ARCHITECTURE.md rule 2).

params.fix: Add an Alembic data migration that rewrites the stored values, and update the Vue UI and Slack plugin comparisons in the same PR.

rules.title: Model changes ship with a migration
rules.statement: Adding, removing or renaming a Column requires an Alembic revision in the same PR (ARCHITECTURE.md rule 3).

rules.title: Permissions and configuration are a security surface
rules.statement: Changes to dispatch/auth/permissions.py or dispatch/config.py need a ticket that names them (ARCHITECTURE.md rule 5).

rules.title: Cost multipliers are policy, not bugs
rules.statement: incident_cost/service.py role multipliers reflect a documented policy; changing who counts toward cost is a product decision (ARCHITECTURE.md rule 6).
